text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Monday it raised Effective Management Systems Inc to buy from hold, after the company said it expected to report fourth quarter earnings above Dain Bosworth's estimate.
-- The company said it expected to report earnings for the fourth quarter ended in November of $0.16 a share, better than Dain Bosworth's $0.07 a share estimate, Dain Bosworth said.
-- "The company finally achieves profitability after building infrastructure for the past 12 months," Dain Bosworth said in a research report.
-- Twelve-month target price is $10.75, Dain Bosworth said. The stock was down 1/2 at 6-3/4 Monday.
